Provide technical support and guidance for hardware, software, network, and system-related issues. Lead and supervise the IT support team , assign tasks, monitor performance, ensure accountability, and follow up on pending issues. Manage and execute IT infrastructure projects , including upgrades, migrations, implementations, expansions, and system improvements. Hands-on experience with VMware ESXi, vCenter, and Hyper-V . Experience with network and system monitoring tools . Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, network security, backups, and system administration. Strong team leadership and people management skills. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical issues and manage multiple priorities. Experience in leading or contributing to IT infrastructure and network projects . Manage site-based MEP and IT Life Cycle Management (LCM) projects. Perform ongoing assessments of infrastructure system operational readiness. Review and enhance preventive and predictive maintenance procedures for all critical infrastructure systems. Ensure 24/7/365 coverage and effective emergency response for infrastructure and IT equipment failures. Five to Ten years of building engineering design management, facilities management, data center management, or related experience. Project management skills. Knowledge of Electrical/Arc Flash Safety (NFPA 70E) Electrical or HVAC licenses would be a plus. Working familiarity with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Cad/BIM Platforms, and Integrated Work Maintenance Management System (IWMS) software. review_candidates.title: Operadora / Operador Máquinas B (Transporte Auxiliar)
review_candidates.description: Descrição da empresa Mais do que uma responsabilidade, Segurança é nosso valor. Junte-se a nós nesse compromisso! Segura. Inteligente. Sustentável. Provavelmente, estas não são as primeiras palavras que você normalmente associa à mineração. Mas a Anglo American não é uma empresa de mineração comum. Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com foco no propósito de "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas". Somos incondicionais diante a segurança, saúde e bem-estar de nossos empregados, seja no trabalho, em casa, e nas comunidades onde trabalhamos. Nosso objetivo é liderar o setor investindo em inovação para proteger as pessoas, que são o coração de nossos negócios. Nossas equipes assumem a responsabilidade por suas próprias ações e dos demais, trabalham de forma colaborativa e sempre demonstram cuidado e respeito. Com sede em Londres, Reino Unido, e operações localizadas em todo o mundo, a Anglo American é realmente uma empresa global. Empregamos mais de 60.000 colegas em todo o mundo e gerenciamos operações de mineração na África do Sul, América do Norte e do Sul e Austrália. No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado nos estados de Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações nos municípios de Barro Alto e Niquelândia, em Goiás. Além disso, temos estrutura corporativa localizada em Belo Horizonte. Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e nossa crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles! Descrição da vaga Você como Operadora / Operador de Máquinas B, será responsável por operar máquinas pesadas acionando comandos mecânicos, hidráulicos e eletrônicos, mediante manual de procedimento operacional e conhecimento prático. Veja abaixo as principais atividades: Realizar carregamento de minério e transportar , escória, carvão, ferroníquel e materiais diversos, operando carregadeira de pneus, escavadeira hidráulica, motoniveladora, trator de esteira e caminhão basculante. Realizar manutenção e melhoria em vias de acesso, operando motoniveladora. Contrapilhar minério, escória e carvão. Retirar caçambas com a utilização de caminhão brook. Umectar vias com a utilização de caminhão pipa. Transportar insumos e outros materiais para as diversas áreas da planta industrial “carga seca". Efetuar controle diário das horas/máquina trabalhadas, fazendo anotações em planilhas. Efetuar inspeções e limpeza nas máquinas, no início e término da jornada, checando as variáveis de funcionamento e retirando a sujeita. Auxiliar o mecânico de máquinas e o lubrificador na identificação e diagnóstico de falhas dos equipamentos. Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança e Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial. Qualificações O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição: Ensino Médio Completo; Curso Técnico em Mineração ou Metalurgia será um diferencial; Experiência em operação de máquinas pesadas (motoniveladora, trator de esteira, pá carregadeira, escavadeira hidráulica, caminhão pipa e caminhão caçamba e brook); Carteira de Habilitação "D"; Disponibilidade para atuar em turno e no administrativo. Informações adicionais Por que fazer parte do nosso time? Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios: Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental: Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (extensivo a você e seus dependentes), além de Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional Especial para você e sua família: Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação! Espaço para ser você mesmo: Fique à vontade para participar de nossos Grupos de Afinidades e dos eventos incríveis da Semana da Diversidade! Para seu futuro: Plano de Previdência Privada diferenciado E ainda: Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico. Como estamos comprometidos com a sua segurança? Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Para que isso aconteça, temos os padrões de segurança mais rigorosos do setor. Além disso, também estamos investindo continuamente em novas tecnologias, de drones a análise de dados, que estão ajudando a tornar a mineração mais segura. Inclusão e Diversidade Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, no qual valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega por quem ela/ele é. Acolhemos e celebramos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. E foi para escutar todas essas vozes que criamos os Grupos de Afinidades: espaços seguros para discutir, refletir e construir ações de inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional. Nós queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e sintam-se abertos para trazer seu “verdadeiro eu” para o trabalho. Reforçamos que todas as vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS. Nosso processo seletivo Para se candidatar a essa vaga, realize seu cadastro on-line, e anexe seu currículo no ato da inscrição. Nosso processo seletivo, de forma geral, é constituído das seguintes etapas: inscrição, análise dos currículos, dinâmica/entrevista, avaliação comportamental, exame médico e admissão. Fique atento à página da/do candidata/candidato, assim como aos meios de comunicação (e-mail, telefone, WhatsApp), pois todo o processo será mediado por essas plataformas. Venha com a gente construir o futuro da mineração!

review_candidates.title: Climate and Food Security Specialist
review_candidates.description: DRC Uganda is currently looking for a highly qualified and motivated individual to join our dynamic team as Climate and Food security Specialist. This role is contingent upon the successful securing of funding for the project. The overall purpose of the role: The Climate & Food Security Specialist will support in developing, implementing, and evaluating climate adaptation strategies under DRC's Food Systems and Economic Self-Reliance project in West Nile. He/she will ensure providing proactive measures of smooth implementation of the project ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of interventions under the project. Enhance food and nutrition security and economic self-reliance among refugees and host communities through climate-resilient, inclusive and market-oriented food systems. The position holder will work closely with the Project Manager, Climate & Food Security Team Leader and MEAL team. They will work on raising climate change awareness, advocating for resilience practices, and engaging the project team and stakeholders to foster a holistic approach to climate resilience. Your main duties and responsibilities will be: Technical Leadership and Programme Quality Provide overall technical leadership and quality assurance across the project's food systems, food and nutrition security and economic self-reliance interventions. Oversee implementation of climate-smart and regenerative agriculture interventions, including block/cluster farming, Resilience Design, provision of agricultural inputs,good agronomic practices, soil and water conservation, post-harvest management and farmer learning. Ensure effective implementation of nutrition-sensitive approaches, including kitchen gardening/ permaculture, diversified household food production and nutrition education, particularly for refugee households with limited access to productive land. Provide technical oversight to market systems interventions, including value-chain development, aggregation and collective marketing, value addition, market information and linkages between farmer groups, off-takers and other market actors. Guide implementation of financial inclusion approaches, including access to financial services and strengthening farmer groups towards associations, cooperatives and SACCOs Oversee natural resource and ecosystem management interventions, including Farmer-Managed Natural Regeneration (FMNR), agroforestry, restoration of degraded landscapes, water for production, soil and water conservation and household tree-growing approaches. Ensure technical quality and sustainability of alternative livelihood interventions, including beekeeping, fish farming, small-scale solar irrigation, tree nursery enterprises, clean-energy solutions and fodder systems, as applicable. Ensure gender equality and women's empowerment are integrated across project interventions, including women's participation in leadership and decision-making and equitable access to land, productive resources and economic opportunities. Ensure youth, persons with disabilities, refugees and host communities are appropriately included across project interventions in line with agreed targeting and inclusion approaches. Ensure project interventions build on and strengthen existing project farmer groups, delivery systems, extension structures, local-government relationships and tested technical approaches rather than establishing parallel systems. Facilitate access to appropriate technical expertise from DRC specialists, District Local Governments and other relevant actors and ensure identified gaps are addressed. Ensure required technical training programs for project employees are implemented. Prepare quality progress reports in line with agreed outcomes/activities in Annual work plans. Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Work closely with MEAL staff to operationalise the project MEAL-framework and ensure systematic monitoring of outputs, outcomes, indicators and project quality. Ensure timely and accurate collection, analysis and use of project data to monitor progress and inform programme and management decisions. Ensure appropriate accountability and feedback mechanisms are accessible to refugee and host-community participants and that feedback is analysed and used to improve project delivery. Promote documentation of project results, success stories, lessons learned, innovations and good practices for learning, communication and potential replication or scale-up. Monitor implementation of project activities and support implementation of M&E process. Coordination, Partnerships and Representation Initiate and maintain effective engagement with key stakeholders at District Local Government and Lower Local Government levels and follow-up on recommendations (Collaboration) in his or jurisdiction. Coordinate closely with district technical departments and extension structures to strengthen technical quality, alignment with local priorities, government ownership and sustainability. Represent DRC and the project in relevant donor engagements, coordination forums, technical working groups, government meetings and other external platforms as delegated. Strengthen engagement with farmer groups, refugee and host-community structures, women and youth groups and other community institutions to promote meaningful participation, ownership and sustainability. Facilitate strategic engagement with private-sector actors, including agro-input suppliers, off-takers, millers, financial institutions and other service providers, to strengthen market access and commercially viable livelihood opportunities. Coordinate with other humanitarian and development actors to promote complementarity, leverage existing investments and avoid duplication. Lead and participate in joint field monitoring, technical supervision, learning visits and review missions with government, donor and other relevant stakeholders. Maintain strong linkages with other relevant DRC programmes/projects to ensure complementarity, shared learning and efficient use of established systems and structures. Coordinate the implementation of all project activities and ensure all the outcome targets are met. About You To be successful in this role, you must have at least minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in food security, agriculture, livelihoods, resilience or related programming, including at least 2 years in project management and/or technical leadership roles. moreover, we also expect the following. Required Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, Agricultural Economics, Agribusiness, Food Security, Natural Resource Management or related field. Demonstrated experience managing complex projects, including planning, budgeting, implementation oversight, team management, monitoring and donor reporting. Strong understanding of climate-resilient agriculture, food systems and market-oriented livelihoods programming, with the ability to provide technical oversight and ensure programme quality. Experience managing and coordinating multidisciplinary teams and working across different technical and operational functions. Strong understanding of project cycle management, financial management and results-based management, with demonstrated ability to manage budgets, workplans, risks and project performance. Experience working with government, private-sector actors, community structures and other programme stakeholders, preferably in refugee-hosting or displacement-affected settings. Demonstrated ability to integrate gender, inclusion, accountability and safeguarding into programme implementation. Strong leadership, analytical, communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results. Full professional proficiency in (written & spoken) English. Desirable Master’s degree in agriculture, Agricultural Economics, Food Security, Rural Development or a related field is an added advantage. Professional training or certification in project/programme management, climate-smart agriculture, market systems development or related areas is an added advantage. Knowledge of languages spoken in the project locations. In this position, you are expected to demonstrate DRC’s five core competencies: Striving for excellence : You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. Communicating : You listen and speak effectively and honestly. Demonstrating integrity : You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. We offer Contract length: 12 months Band: G2 Designation of Duty Station: Arua Start date: October 2026 Salary and conditions will be in accordance with Danish Refugee Council’s Terms of Employment for national employees; please refer to our website . Application process All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. Applications sent by email will not be considered. Closing date for applications: 13th September 2026 DRC does not solicit money for any part of its recruitment process. All recruitment is merit-based and follows HR best practices that are globally acceptable. Henceforth, should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it For further information about the Danish Refugee Council, please consult our website drc.ngo .

review_candidates.title: Staff Mechanical Engineer - Spacecraft Components
review_candidates.description: About The Role Muon seeks a Staff Mechanical Engineer to be a technical owner for spacecraft mechanisms and components design; own single-point-failure management (margin, redundancy, test coverage); own component qualification (deployment, life, and environmental testing). The ideal candidate can go deep on design while carrying a "systems mindset" — a force multiplier who collaborates across disciplines to arrive at an elegant, well-balanced design. You'll start from Muon's platform building blocks, tailor and design hardware to meet mission needs, and pull in the right stakeholders (structural, thermal, electrical, systems) at the right times to deliver on time. Being an early-stage company with small teams, breadth is essential: you'll have touch points across engineering, production, and program management. As a staff engineer you'll own strategy spanning multiple subsystems. You'll set platform-level mechanical architecture, define complex complex test campaigns, and own designs across multiple concurrent missions on a six-month-to-year-plus horizon. You'll be the go-to escalation point for the non-routine problems that stump the team. Due to the hands-on nature of this role, it requires onsite work at our San Jose location 3x days a week. What You'll Do Own the mechanical direction of your spacecraft component or mechanisms; from requirements definition through design, build, test, and launch-vehicle integration Create, analyze, and refine mechanical designs in SolidWorks; tailor Muon's platform components and design new components where required Perform first-order structural, dynamic, and thermal sizing to guide designs; partner with Muon's dedicated structural and thermal analysis groups on detailed analysis and correlation Make economically sound make-vs-buy decisions, balancing rapid capability demonstration with the path to constellation-scale production Lead the mechanical portion of internal and external design reviews (PDR, CDR, MRR) Lead component/subsystem environmental test campaigns (vibration, TVAC, shock) and disposition results Produce and release engineering documentation: drawings, GD&T, BOMs, tolerance/mass budgets, and build procedures under configuration control (ECO/DCO, PLM) Contribute to maturing Muon's mechanical engineering standards, tools, and culture Own the mechanical architecture and design direction of components for usage across platform/satellite class, balancing multiple concurrent and future missions Engage directly with stakeholders and launch providers on interfaces, environments, margins, and acceptance criteria; contribute mechanical content to proposals. Define, document, and champion mechanical design standards, review processes, and best practices that scale across the organization Act as a force multiplier — mentor engineers at all levels, chair design reviews Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience designing, building, and testing high-reliability hardware B.S. or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field Proficiency in CAD (SolidWorks preferred) for medium-to-large assembly design and management Mastery of drawings, GD&T, BOMs, FAIs, tolerance budgets, and mass budgets Experience with ECO/DCO processes and PLM systems Demonstrated proficiency leading mechanical design for complex electromechanical systems Extensive documentation capabilities: build procedures, test plans, design trades, DOEs Experience managing external vendors for part prototyping and development Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional coordination skills Strong mentorship skills. Demonstrated experience creating technical documents (ESOW, Technical Specification, DFMEA, Test Verification Plan) Experience owning a components used across platform, product line, or major subsystems Recognized depth in a specialty (e.g., Mechanisms, Composites, or Dynamics) with industry references Customer-facing experience: technical interchanges, requirements discussions, or proposal contributions Nice-to-have Skills Flight heritage on the following components: Gimbaled Devices, Separation/Launch Interface, Electrical Modules, Battery Packs, Reaction Wheel, CMG, Magnetorquer, Star Trackers, Propulsion, Radiators, Instrument Packaging, Instrument Scan Mechanisms Experience optimizing and maturing existing designs (not only clean-sheet development) Familiarity with satellite payloads and mission-level mechanical integration Experience running structural analyses (FEMAP, ANSYS, NASTRAN) and environmental testing Experience with thermal management systems for spacecraft Large-assembly management in SolidWorks PDM; PLM systems (Duro or similar) Software skills in Python, MATLAB, or similar Qualifying mechanisms to NASA-STD-5017, ECSS, or equivalent. Salary The salary range for this role is $202,000 - $223,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process. About Muon Space Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world. Taking Care of Our Team At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave. Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know. ITAR/EAR Requirements This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. L'Hôpital Universitaire International de Rabat (HUIR) est à la recherche d'un Responsable des relations Hôpital Médecins de ville (H/F) qualifié (e) et motivé (e) pour rejoindre notre équipe. Il/elle est le garant du narratif de l'établissement sur ces canaux : ligne éditoriale, production de contenus, animation et modération des communautés et pilotage des campagnes digitales, en cohérence avec la plateforme de marque définie par la Direction de la Communication. Le poste suppose une forte appropriation de l'identité et des valeurs de l'Hôpital UIR, une grande autonomie opérationnelle et une veille active et permanente des usages, codes et tendances des réseaux sociaux. Responsabilités Stratégie éditoriale & maîtrise des codes par plateforme Définir une ligne éditoriale différenciée par plateforme (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube...), adaptée aux codes, formats et usages propres à chacune. Décoder les logiques de recommandation et les mécaniques d'engagement propres à chaque plateforme pour maximiser la portée organique des contenus. Animer les communautés au quotidien : publication, modération, réponses, veille de la e-réputation. Garantir le respect des codes graphiques et des codes propres à chaque plateforme dans tous les contenus produits. Production de contenus Concevoir et produire des visuels en autonomie via des outils professionnels (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, ou Figma). Canva peut compléter mais ne remplace pas ces outils. Réaliser des captations photo et vidéo pour l'ensemble des supports (site web, réseaux sociaux, supports internes, marque employeur) : cadrage, lumière, son, storytelling adapté aux codes natifs de chaque plateforme, et assurer le montage et la retouche en autonomie (CapCut, Premiere Pro). Veille active et permanente des tendances et nouveaux usages. Vous identifiez ce qui émerge avant que ce ne soit mainstream. Bilinguisme français / arabe dialectal indispensable : excellente maîtrise rédactionnelle dans les deux langues, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Maîtrise d'outils professionnels de création (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma). Canva seul ne suffit pas pour ce poste. Notions solides de tournage au smartphone (cadrage, lumière, son) et de montage (CapCut ; Premiere Pro apprécié). Maîtrise des outils de gestion, de programmation et d'analyse des réseaux sociaux (Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, outils de planification et de reporting). Connaissance des leviers de marketing digital : social ads, paid media, SEA, campagnes de notoriété et d'engagement. Aisance rédactionnelle et créativité, avec une vraie sensibilité pour le storytelling de marque. Forte appétence pour les réseaux sociaux et une culture digitale à jour. Exigence et sens critique sur la qualité des contenus avant diffusion. Créativité et capacité à transformer un besoin en concept clair, pertinent et exploitable. Sens du détail, rigueur et sensibilité à l'image de marque. Curiosité, agilité et capacité à s'approprier rapidement les nouveaux usages et technologies, notamment liés au digital et à l'Intelligence Artificielle. Autonomie et réactivité, avec le sens du travail en équipe et du relationnel. Sensibilité particulière au secteur de la santé, avec la rigueur et la discrétion qu'exige la communication autour de sujets médicaux. review_candidates.location: Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo
review_candidates.description: he Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) has been active in the OWR for more than 30 years, supporting its creation, and subsequently working closely with ICCN (Institut Congolaise pour la Conservation de la Nature) – the government agency responsible for protected areas and wildlife - in its management. In December 2018, WCS and ICCN signed a 10-year management agreement that delegates management authority of the OWR to WCS, and which was initiated in September 2019. This mandate is implemented through an OWR Management Unit (RMU) that is the executive body in charge of all day-to-day management activities and personnel in the OWR. The Reserve Director is a WCS-appointed position in charge of the RMU. Created in 1992, the OWR, at more than 13,000km2, is the single largest protected tract of intact lowland tropical forest remaining in the DRC. Working closely with IT teams, and campus partners, the AI Solutions Manager helps departments identify meaningful opportunities to use agentic AI to improve academic, administrative, research, and operational outcomes. This role translates campus needs into clear AI use cases, assesses value and readiness, coordinates stakeholder alignment, and helps ensure that AI work is prioritized, adopted, and measured in a responsible and sustainable way. This is a high-visibility individual contributor role that requires strong relationship-building, analytical judgment, change management experience, business acumen, and the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences. The AI Solutions Manager does not manage people; the role manages the AI opportunity pipeline, campus engagement process, adoption lifecycle, and value-realization activities for AI-enabled solutions. This position currently operates in a hybrid work model with regular campus presence required. Work arrangements are subject to change based on institutional needs. The successful candidate must be able to commute to campus in Golden, Colorado. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position now nor in the future. Primary Responsibilities AI OPPORTUNITY INTAKE, PIPELINE MANAGEMENT, AND PRIORITIZATION SUPPORT Serve as the primary front door for campus AI opportunities, ideas, use cases, and requests from academic, administrative, research, and operational units. Build and maintain an organized AI opportunity pipeline that captures request details, business needs, expected outcomes, stakeholders, readiness factors, dependencies, risks, and status. Meet with campus partners to understand pain points, opportunities, goals, current processes, service impacts, customer needs, and potential value of AI-enabled solutions. Shape early ideas into clear, actionable use cases that can be evaluated by the AI Acceleration team and institutional decision-makers. Assess incoming opportunities for institutional alignment, business value, feasibility, urgency, complexity, risk, readiness, data needs, governance considerations, accessibility, privacy, security, and sustainability. Develop prioritization recommendations for review by the Director of AI Acceleration and appropriate governance or leadership groups. Partner with the Senior Project Manager to transition approved AI opportunities into structured project planning and delivery processes. Track the AI opportunity pipeline and prepare summaries, dashboards, presentations, or decision-support materials for leadership, governance groups, and stakeholders. Evaluate potential solution approaches, including AI-enabled solutions, enterprise applications, workflow automation, process improvements, vendor products, and existing technology capabilities, to help identify practical and sustainable paths forward. review_candidates.title: Cyberdivisionen søger it-supporter til Lokal IT Servicecenter i Karup
review_candidates.description: Har du lyst til at være IT-Supporter på en spændende og dynamisk arbejdsplads, hvor du kan realisere din lyst til faglighed og personlig udvikling samt kontakt til mange forskellige mennesker? Så skal du til tasterne og sende os din ansøgning. Om os Vi er et hold af engagerede og dygtige IT-medarbejdere. Det Lokale IT-element er et team på 15 medarbejdere (1 Leder, 11 fastansatte og 4 elever). Vi er en del af de regionale servicecentre, der dækker Midt- og Nordjylland. Lokal IT Servicecenter Karup løser de lokale IT-opgaver for mange brugere på Karup Flyvestation og andre lokaliteter i området i tæt samarbejde med LITS i Regionen. I forbindelse med overgang til en ny organisation og en forventelig forøgelse af kundegrundlaget, vil arbejdet på sigt omfatte en øget aktivitet. Lokal IT Servicecenter Karup er en del af Cyberdivisionen ved Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse. Styrelsen har hovedkvarter i Ballerup, hvorfra dele af programmets opgaver udføres. Opgaverne er mangeartede, og omfatter blandt andet brugersupport samt drift af administrative netværk og IT-systemer. Vores arbejdsdag er præget af tillid og fleksibilitet. Vi tager et fælles ansvar for trivslen, har en uformel omgangstone samt en åben og ærlig dialog. Stillingen indeholder spændende udfordringer inden for konfiguration og support af administrative IT-systemer, samt direkte brugersupport i et operativt miljø, hvor driftsstabilitet og sikkerhed er altafgørende. Om stillingen Du kommer til at varetage mange spændende og alsidige opgaver inden for drift, service og supportområdet. I jobbet indgår du i vores serviceteam, hvor du giver vores kunder 1. og 2. level support. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil variere fra enkelte telefonsupportopgaver til personlig kontakt til brugere med forskellige baggrunde. Det er derfor altafgørende, at du befinder dig godt i et job med varierende arbejdsopgaver, hvor du kan tilpasse dig efter brugerens behov og viden. Du vil også bidrage til udviklingen af lokal IT i Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Der vil blandt andet være tale om opgaver, som: Installation, vedligeholdelse og optimering af fortrinsvis Microsoft løsninger Grundlæggende materialehåndtering Klargøring og installation af PC Opsætning og brugersupport på mobil telefoni Fejlfinding på hardware og netværk Brugeradministration og brugersupport Undervisning af brugere i nye systemer Du vil opleve en travl, men alsidig hverdag i et dynamisk miljø, hvor to dage sjældent er ens og hvor du selv, inden for centrets mål og rammer, bidrager til en spændende, lærerig og udfordrende hverdag. Har du lyst og evner, er der desuden gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. Om dig Vi forestiller os at du har en faglig uddannelse som IT-supporter eller Datafagtekniker. Du er dygtig til trådløst og kablet netværk. Du har en interesse for PC-hardware og Microsoft produkter, som server 2020 og derefter og Windows 10/11. Du skal have kørekort kategori B og så skal du kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes. Du skal kunne dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale. Vi lægger stor vægt på, at du kan organisere dit arbejde effektivt. Du skal, når opgaven er stillet, af egen drift få den udført. Du er en udpræget holdspiller med gode samarbejdsevner, en tydelig kommunikation og så er det vigtigt, at du har gode sociale færdigheder. Vi forventer desuden af dig, at du engagerer dig i arbejdet og er positiv i din omgang med kolleger og brugere. God sans for humor, ”brede skuldre” og videndeling er 3 vigtige faktorer i din dagligdag. Ansættelsesvilkår Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning. Arbejdsstedet er på Flyvestation Karup. Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet. Stillingen kan både besættes af personel med civil såvel som militær baggrund, og er derfor slået op både civilt og militært. Vær derfor opmærksom på stillingens ”værn”, når du søger via linket i stillingsopslaget. Kontakt og ansøgning Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte lederen af Lokal IT Karup, Jacob Køpke på telefon 4080 2100 eller regionschef Timmy Nielsen på telefon 2131 6551. Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Mia Nordbeck Carlsson på telefon 3266 5716. Ansøgningsfristen er den 18. september 2026 og vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler derefter. Vi venter gerne på den rigtige kandidat. Stillingen er til besættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi vil bede dig om at søge stillingen via linket. For at komme i betragtning til stillingen skal du vedhæfte CV, ansøgning og uddannelsesbevis samt andre relevante dokumenter. I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen. Om Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er en styrelse under Forsvarsministeriet. FMI har ansvaret for det samlede forsvars og beredskabs materiel, IT og cybersikkerhed. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og IT for såvel Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet, Arktisk Kommando, Specialoperationskommandoen, Hjemmeværnet, Beredskabsstyrelsen og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Desuden bistår vores IT-medarbejdere dagligt i at modstå de cyberangreb, Forsvarsministeriets koncern udsættes for. Vi er ca. 2500 medarbejdere (3/4 civile - 1/4 militære) fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget, med hovedkontorer i henholdsvis Ballerup, Brabrand og Hvidovre.

Nosso objetivo é liderar o setor investindo em inovação para proteger as pessoas, que são o coração de nossos negócios. Nossas equipes assumem a responsabilidade por suas próprias ações e dos demais, trabalham de forma colaborativa e sempre demonstram cuidado e respeito. Com sede em Londres, Reino Unido, e operações localizadas em todo o mundo, a Anglo American é realmente uma empresa global. Empregamos mais de 60.000 colegas em todo o mundo e gerenciamos operações de mineração na África do Sul, América do Norte e do Sul e Austrália. No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado nos estados de Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações nos municípios de Barro Alto e Niquelândia, em Goiás. Além disso, temos estrutura corporativa localizada em Belo Horizonte. Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e nossa crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles! Descrição da vaga Você como Operadora / Operador de Máquinas B, será responsável por operar máquinas pesadas acionando comandos mecânicos, hidráulicos e eletrônicos, mediante manual de procedimento operacional e conhecimento prático. Veja abaixo as principais atividades: Realizar carregamento de minério e transportar , escória, carvão, ferroníquel e materiais diversos, operando carregadeira de pneus, escavadeira hidráulica, motoniveladora, trator de esteira e caminhão basculante. Realizar manutenção e melhoria em vias de acesso, operando motoniveladora. Contrapilhar minério, escória e carvão. Retirar caçambas com a utilização de caminhão brook. Umectar vias com a utilização de caminhão pipa. Transportar insumos e outros materiais para as diversas áreas da planta industrial “carga seca". Efetuar controle diário das horas/máquina trabalhadas, fazendo anotações em planilhas. Efetuar inspeções e limpeza nas máquinas, no início e término da jornada, checando as variáveis de funcionamento e retirando a sujeita. Auxiliar o mecânico de máquinas e o lubrificador na identificação e diagnóstico de falhas dos equipamentos. Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança e Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial. Qualificações O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição: Ensino Médio Completo; Curso Técnico em Mineração ou Metalurgia será um diferencial; Experiência em operação de máquinas pesadas (motoniveladora, trator de esteira, pá carregadeira, escavadeira hidráulica, caminhão pipa e caminhão caçamba e brook); Carteira de Habilitação "D"; Disponibilidade para atuar em turno e no administrativo. Informações adicionais Por que fazer parte do nosso time? Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios: Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental: Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (extensivo a você e seus dependentes), além de Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional Especial para você e sua família: Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação! Espaço para ser você mesmo: Fique à vontade para participar de nossos Grupos de Afinidades e dos eventos incríveis da Semana da Diversidade! Para seu futuro: Plano de Previdência Privada diferenciado E ainda: Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico. Como estamos comprometidos com a sua segurança? Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Para que isso aconteça, temos os padrões de segurança mais rigorosos do setor. Além disso, também estamos investindo continuamente em novas tecnologias, de drones a análise de dados, que estão ajudando a tornar a mineração mais segura. Inclusão e Diversidade Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, no qual valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega por quem ela/ele é. Acolhemos e celebramos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. E foi para escutar todas essas vozes que criamos os Grupos de Afinidades: espaços seguros para discutir, refletir e construir ações de inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional. Nós queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e sintam-se abertos para trazer seu “verdadeiro eu” para o trabalho. Reforçamos que todas as vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS. Nosso processo seletivo Para se candidatar a essa vaga, realize seu cadastro on-line, e anexe seu currículo no ato da inscrição. Nosso processo seletivo, de forma geral, é constituído das seguintes etapas: inscrição, análise dos currículos, dinâmica/entrevista, avaliação comportamental, exame médico e admissão. Fique atento à página da/do candidata/candidato, assim como aos meios de comunicação (e-mail, telefone, WhatsApp), pois todo o processo será mediado por essas plataformas. Venha com a gente construir o futuro da mineração!

Ensure youth, persons with disabilities, refugees and host communities are appropriately included across project interventions in line with agreed targeting and inclusion approaches. Monitor implementation of project activities and support implementation of M&E process. Coordination, Partnerships and Representation Initiate and maintain effective engagement with key stakeholders at District Local Government and Lower Local Government levels and follow-up on recommendations (Collaboration) in his or jurisdiction. Coordinate closely with district technical departments and extension structures to strengthen technical quality, alignment with local priorities, government ownership and sustainability. Represent DRC and the project in relevant donor engagements, coordination forums, technical working groups, government meetings and other external platforms as delegated. Strengthen engagement with farmer groups, refugee and host-community structures, women and youth groups and other community institutions to promote meaningful participation, ownership and sustainability. Facilitate strategic engagement with private-sector actors, including agro-input suppliers, off-takers, millers, financial institutions and other service providers, to strengthen market access and commercially viable livelihood opportunities. Coordinate with other humanitarian and development actors to promote complementarity, leverage existing investments and avoid duplication. Lead and participate in joint field monitoring, technical supervision, learning visits and review missions with government, donor and other relevant stakeholders. Maintain strong linkages with other relevant DRC programmes/projects to ensure complementarity, shared learning and efficient use of established systems and structures. Coordinate the implementation of all project activities and ensure all the outcome targets are met. About You To be successful in this role, you must have at least minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in food security, agriculture, livelihoods, resilience or related programming, including at least 2 years in project management and/or technical leadership roles. moreover, we also expect the following. Required Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, Agricultural Economics, Agribusiness, Food Security, Natural Resource Management or related field. Mission Nous recherchons un(e) Social Media Manager expérimenté(e) et rigoureux(se) pour rejoindre notre Direction de la Communication et des Relations Publiques à l'Hôpital UIR. Le poste ne consiste pas à décliner un même contenu partout, mais à comprendre et exploiter les codes, les algorithmes et les usages propres à chaque réseau pour produire des contenus qui performent réellement tout en respectant la rigueur et la confiance qu'exige un environnement hospitalier. Le ou la Social Media Manager pilote au quotidien la présence de l'Hôpital UIR sur les réseaux sociaux et ses leviers d'acquisition digitale. Il/elle est le garant du narratif de l'établissement sur ces canaux : ligne éditoriale, production de contenus, animation et modération des communautés et pilotage des campagnes digitales, en cohérence avec la plateforme de marque définie par la Direction de la Communication. Le poste suppose une forte appropriation de l'identité et des valeurs de l'Hôpital UIR, une grande autonomie opérationnelle et une veille active et permanente des usages, codes et tendances des réseaux sociaux. Responsabilités Stratégie éditoriale & maîtrise des codes par plateforme Définir une ligne éditoriale différenciée par plateforme (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube...), adaptée aux codes, formats et usages propres à chacune. Construire et piloter le calendrier éditorial, aligné avec la stratégie d'expansion et les temps forts de l'Hôpital UIR, en français, arabe et darija. Décoder les logiques de recommandation et les mécaniques d'engagement propres à chaque plateforme pour maximiser la portée organique des contenus. Animer les communautés au quotidien : publication, modération, réponses, veille de la e-réputation. Garantir le respect des codes graphiques et des codes propres à chaque plateforme dans tous les contenus produits. Production de contenus Concevoir et produire des visuels en autonomie via des outils professionnels (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, ou Figma). Canva peut compléter mais ne remplace pas ces outils. Réaliser des captations photo et vidéo pour l'ensemble des supports (site web, réseaux sociaux, supports internes, marque employeur) : cadrage, lumière, son, storytelling adapté aux codes natifs de chaque plateforme, et assurer le montage et la retouche en autonomie (CapCut, Premiere Pro). Rédiger les scripts et préparer les tournages (portraits médecins, podcasts, capsules institutionnelles, témoignages...), en coordination avec les prestataires externes, et faire le lien technique entre la Direction de la Communication et les équipes de tournage. Constituer et gérer une photothèque / vidéothèque institutionnelle (le « frigo de contenu ») pour un usage réactif toute l'année. Marketing digital & performance Piloter les campagnes digitales (social ads, paid media, SEA) et les leviers d'acquisition, d'engagement et de fidélisation. Adapter les formats publicitaires aux spécificités de chaque plateforme (Reels Ads, Stories Ads, Sponsored LinkedIn...) plutôt que d'appliquer un format unique. Suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (portée, engagement, conversions) et produire des reportings réguliers. Contribuer à la gestion des situations de crise sur les canaux digitaux. Veille & maîtrise des tendances Assurer une veille active et continue des tendances, formats émergents et évolutions des plateformes sociales, y compris sur des canaux où l'Hôpital UIR n'est pas encore présent. Suivre en continu l'évolution des algorithmes et des bonnes pratiques par plateforme, au-delà des tendances superficielles. Identifier et tester de nouveaux formats, outils et usages, y compris les outils de création assistée par IA. Assurer une veille concurrentielle sur la communication santé/hospitalière, au Maroc comme à l'international. Profil Formation : Bac+5 en Marketing, Communication, Communication Digitale ou formation équivalente. Expérience Expérience confirmée de 3 à 5 ans minimum en social media management, dans un contexte exigeant (agence, marque forte, ou environnement à forte sensibilité réputationnelle), avec une pratique réelle et régulière de la production de contenus (visuels et vidéo). Une véritable maîtrise des codes, formats et mécaniques propres à chaque plateforme, au-delà des compétences généralistes de community management, est indispensable. Qualités Professionnelles Requises Maîtrise fine des codes et formats natifs de chaque réseau social (Reels, Stories, LinkedIn...) et compréhension des logiques algorithmiques et des mécaniques de viralité propres à chaque plateforme. Veille active et permanente des tendances et nouveaux usages. Vous identifiez ce qui émerge avant que ce ne soit mainstream. Bilinguisme français / arabe dialectal indispensable : excellente maîtrise rédactionnelle dans les deux langues, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Maîtrise d'outils professionnels de création (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma). Canva seul ne suffit pas pour ce poste. Notions solides de tournage au smartphone (cadrage, lumière, son) et de montage (CapCut ; Premiere Pro apprécié). Maîtrise des outils de gestion, de programmation et d'analyse des réseaux sociaux (Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, outils de planification et de reporting). Connaissance des leviers de marketing digital : social ads, paid media, SEA, campagnes de notoriété et d'engagement. Aisance rédactionnelle et créativité, avec une vraie sensibilité pour le storytelling de marque. Forte appétence pour les réseaux sociaux et une culture digitale à jour. Exigence et sens critique sur la qualité des contenus avant diffusion. Créativité et capacité à transformer un besoin en concept clair, pertinent et exploitable. Sens du détail, rigueur et sensibilité à l'image de marque. Curiosité, agilité et capacité à s'approprier rapidement les nouveaux usages et technologies, notamment liés au digital et à l'Intelligence Artificielle. Autonomie et réactivité, avec le sens du travail en équipe et du relationnel. Sensibilité particulière au secteur de la santé, avec la rigueur et la discrétion qu'exige la communication autour de sujets médicaux. Rejoignez-nous et contribuez à la mission de l'Hôpital Universitaire International de Rabat ! new_matches.title: Director, Okapi Wildlife Reserve, Democratic Republic of Congo
new_matches.location: Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo
new_matches.description: he Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) has been active in the OWR for more than 30 years, supporting its creation, and subsequently working closely with ICCN (Institut Congolaise pour la Conservation de la Nature) – the government agency responsible for protected areas and wildlife - in its management. In December 2018, WCS and ICCN signed a 10-year management agreement that delegates management authority of the OWR to WCS, and which was initiated in September 2019. This mandate is implemented through an OWR Management Unit (RMU) that is the executive body in charge of all day-to-day management activities and personnel in the OWR. The Reserve Director is a WCS-appointed position in charge of the RMU. Created in 1992, the OWR, at more than 13,000km2, is the single largest protected tract of intact lowland tropical forest remaining in the DRC. The OWR harbors one of the largest remaining populations of forest elephants and the largest stronghold of okapi in the DRC and the single largest population of the eastern chimpanzee in Africa. OWR is situated in the larger Ituri landscape; comprising more than 40,000km2 of contiguous forests, in which WCS is actively building conservation constituencies and supporting sustainable agricultural practices amongst the local communities who depend upon the forest resources for their livelihoods, and on whom the future integrity of the OWR is inextricably linked. The Ituri forests also have a rich cultural heritage and are home to the indigenous Mbuti and Efé peoples. Based in Epulu, Okapi Wildlife Reserve, Democratic Republic of Congo – Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) seeks to appoint a DIRECTOR, OKAPI WILDLIFE RESERVE, DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO WCS seeks a highly experienced manager in the role of OWR Director who can lead the OWR through the next phase of its management contract. The Director will provide strategic and operational leadership and be responsible for all aspects of Reserve management including ranger deployment and wildlife protection, community liaison, research, tourism development, fundraising and reporting, communications, M&E, and capacity building of national staff. The job includes staff management and development, establishing and maintaining strong relationships with government partners, including state enforcement agencies, partner agencies and organizations, as well as oversight of a significant budget and ensuring efficient day-to-day program operations. The Reserve Director is based permanently on-site at the OWR headquarters in Epulu, Ituri Province. The Reserve has a large staff of around 300, working across six Departments. Candidates will need to clearly demonstrate they have the necessary experience, leadership, communication and diplomatic skills with which to manage such a large and complex project in a challenging and insecure area. Overall responsibilities for the position include but are not limited to: Assuring full financial and operational responsibility of the OWR and its staff, including anti-poaching, research and ecological monitoring, community conservation, logistics, M&E, operations and finance and administration Formal liaison with the Steering Committee established under the management contract, and overall responsibility for the coordination of the bi-annual meetings of the Steering Committee and implementation of directives from the Steering Committee Responsibility for the review, update, validation and implementation of the OWR Management Plan, SOPs and Strategic Framework. Strategic oversight of the law enforcement strategy, in consultation with the Deputy Director and in liaison with the CorPPN (Army Corps detached to ICCN for the Protection of National Parks and Reserve), DRC armed forces and the WCS Law Enforcement Advisor Oversight of corrective measures approved by UNESCO to remove the OWR from the list of World Heritage Sites in Danger Official representation to, and actively building and maintaining of relationships with, provincial and national Government, community partners, donors and other key stakeholders in the OWR, including hosting of the annual CoCoSi meetings Assuring that all park operations adhere to Standard Operating Procedures and Interior Regulations of the OWR Management of the RMU and all OWR personnel, including the facilitation of weekly meetings with Heads of Department of the OWRMU Preparation of a recruitment plan, staff evaluation plan and proposals for re-deployment of OWR staff according to the Interior Regulations Participation, as needed, in field operations for the OWR Ensuring monthly and quarterly reporting to WCS, donors and ICCN The Director, Okapi Wildlife Reserve, Democratic Republic of Congo must meet the following functional and experiential criteria: At least 15 years of senior management experience Strong leadership skills and demonstrated experience in managing a large and diverse team Strong diplomacy and decision-making skills in a high-risk environment Proven experience of cultural understanding and leadership in a complex, multicultural and remote environments Excellent communication and negotiating skills Wildlife enforcement training and field experience an advantage Fluency in French and English. Knowledge of Swahili is a distinct advantage Previous experience with international donor organizations A business background or in another professional sector is desirable Previous development or conservation experience in Africa is highly preferred Experience in protected areas or equivalent natural resource management context desirable Commitment to the values and mission of the Wildlife Conservation Society How to Apply View the full job description and application instructions on the Vacancies page at www.actionappointments.co.za/vacancies and email your application by Sunday 15th January 2023 to tracy@actionappointments.co.za

new_matches.title: Cyberdivisionen søger it-supporter til Lokal IT Servicecenter i Karup
new_matches.description: Har du lyst til at være IT-Supporter på en spændende og dynamisk arbejdsplads, hvor du kan realisere din lyst til faglighed og personlig udvikling samt kontakt til mange forskellige mennesker? Så skal du til tasterne og sende os din ansøgning. Om os Vi er et hold af engagerede og dygtige IT-medarbejdere. Det Lokale IT-element er et team på 15 medarbejdere (1 Leder, 11 fastansatte og 4 elever). Vi er en del af de regionale servicecentre, der dækker Midt- og Nordjylland. Lokal IT Servicecenter Karup løser de lokale IT-opgaver for mange brugere på Karup Flyvestation og andre lokaliteter i området i tæt samarbejde med LITS i Regionen. I forbindelse med overgang til en ny organisation og en forventelig forøgelse af kundegrundlaget, vil arbejdet på sigt omfatte en øget aktivitet. Lokal IT Servicecenter Karup er en del af Cyberdivisionen ved Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse. Styrelsen har hovedkvarter i Ballerup, hvorfra dele af programmets opgaver udføres. Opgaverne er mangeartede, og omfatter blandt andet brugersupport samt drift af administrative netværk og IT-systemer. Vores arbejdsdag er præget af tillid og fleksibilitet. Vi tager et fælles ansvar for trivslen, har en uformel omgangstone samt en åben og ærlig dialog. Stillingen indeholder spændende udfordringer inden for konfiguration og support af administrative IT-systemer, samt direkte brugersupport i et operativt miljø, hvor driftsstabilitet og sikkerhed er altafgørende. Om stillingen Du kommer til at varetage mange spændende og alsidige opgaver inden for drift, service og supportområdet. I jobbet indgår du i vores serviceteam, hvor du giver vores kunder 1. og 2. level support. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil variere fra enkelte telefonsupportopgaver til personlig kontakt til brugere med forskellige baggrunde. Det er derfor altafgørende, at du befinder dig godt i et job med varierende arbejdsopgaver, hvor du kan tilpasse dig efter brugerens behov og viden. Du vil også bidrage til udviklingen af lokal IT i Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Der vil blandt andet være tale om opgaver, som: Installation, vedligeholdelse og optimering af fortrinsvis Microsoft løsninger Grundlæggende materialehåndtering Klargøring og installation af PC Opsætning og brugersupport på mobil telefoni Fejlfinding på hardware og netværk Brugeradministration og brugersupport Undervisning af brugere i nye systemer Du vil opleve en travl, men alsidig hverdag i et dynamisk miljø, hvor to dage sjældent er ens og hvor du selv, inden for centrets mål og rammer, bidrager til en spændende, lærerig og udfordrende hverdag. Har du lyst og evner, er der desuden gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. Om dig Vi forestiller os at du har en faglig uddannelse som IT-supporter eller Datafagtekniker. Du er dygtig til trådløst og kablet netværk. Du har en interesse for PC-hardware og Microsoft produkter, som server 2020 og derefter og Windows 10/11. Du skal have kørekort kategori B og så skal du kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes. Du skal kunne dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale. Vi lægger stor vægt på, at du kan organisere dit arbejde effektivt. Du skal, når opgaven er stillet, af egen drift få den udført. Du er en udpræget holdspiller med gode samarbejdsevner, en tydelig kommunikation og så er det vigtigt, at du har gode sociale færdigheder. Vi forventer desuden af dig, at du engagerer dig i arbejdet og er positiv i din omgang med kolleger og brugere. God sans for humor, ”brede skuldre” og videndeling er 3 vigtige faktorer i din dagligdag. Ansættelsesvilkår Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning. Arbejdsstedet er på Flyvestation Karup. Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet. Stillingen kan både besættes af personel med civil såvel som militær baggrund, og er derfor slået op både civilt og militært. Vær derfor opmærksom på stillingens ”værn”, når du søger via linket i stillingsopslaget. Kontakt og ansøgning Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte lederen af Lokal IT Karup, Jacob Køpke på telefon 4080 2100 eller regionschef Timmy Nielsen på telefon 2131 6551. Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Mia Nordbeck Carlsson på telefon 3266 5716. Ansøgningsfristen er den 18. september 2026 og vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler derefter. Vi venter gerne på den rigtige kandidat. Stillingen er til besættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi vil bede dig om at søge stillingen via linket. For at komme i betragtning til stillingen skal du vedhæfte CV, ansøgning og uddannelsesbevis samt andre relevante dokumenter. I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen. Om Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er en styrelse under Forsvarsministeriet. FMI har ansvaret for det samlede forsvars og beredskabs materiel, IT og cybersikkerhed. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og IT for såvel Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet, Arktisk Kommando, Specialoperationskommandoen, Hjemmeværnet, Beredskabsstyrelsen og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Desuden bistår vores IT-medarbejdere dagligt i at modstå de cyberangreb, Forsvarsministeriets koncern udsættes for. Vi er ca. 2500 medarbejdere (3/4 civile - 1/4 militære) fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget, med hovedkontorer i henholdsvis Ballerup, Brabrand og Hvidovre.
